question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
For Rana, unable to see a thing, the parade seemed to last forever.
(CHSL Exam 2024 Tier I)
options: concealment
procession
hiding
darkness
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: procession

Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. For Rana, unable to see a thing, the parade seemed to last forever. - procession

Explanation:
The underlined word "parade" refers to a public procession, often involving a display of people or vehicles moving in an organized manner. "Procession" is the correct synonym as it conveys the same meaning.
परेड शब्द का अर्थ है एक सार्वजनिक जुलूस, जिसमें लोग या वाहन एक व्यवस्थित तरीके से आगे बढ़ते हैं। "Procession" सही पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह समान अर्थ देता है।

Other synonyms Words:
march, cavalcade, motorcade, spectacle, display

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

parade – जुलूस – A public procession, often celebratory or ceremonial.
Example: "The Independence Day parade was spectacular."

concealment – छिपाव – The action of hiding something.
Example: "The thief used clever concealment to hide the stolen goods."

hiding – छिपाना – The act of keeping something out of sight.
Example: "She was in hiding after the scandal."

darkness – अंधकार – The absence of light.
Example: "The room was in complete darkness."

procession – जुलूस – A group of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion.
Example: "The wedding procession moved slowly through the streets."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "procession" is the best synonym for "parade" as both refer to an organized public display of movement. The other words either mean hiding or lack of light, which are unrelated to the context.

Paragon
(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: Grumpy
Associate
Epitome
Transient
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Epitome

Paragon - Epitome

Explanation:
"Paragon" refers to a model of excellence or perfection, and "epitome" means the perfect example of a particular quality or type. Both words convey the idea of an ideal representation.
पैरागन का अर्थ है उत्कृष्टता या पूर्णता का मॉडल, और "एपिटोम" का अर्थ किसी विशेष गुण या प्रकार का आदर्श उदाहरण है। दोनों शब्द एक आदर्श प्रतिनिधित्व का विचार व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Ideal, Exemplar, Model, Standard, Quintessence

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Paragon – आदर्श – A person or thing regarded as a perfect example of a particular quality.
Example: "She is a paragon of virtue and kindness."

Grumpy – चिड़चिड़ा – Bad-tempered or irritable.
Example: "He was grumpy after missing his morning coffee."

Associate – सहयोगी – A partner or colleague in business or work.
Example: "She is my associate in this project."

Transient – अस्थायी – Lasting only for a short time.
Example: "Their happiness was transient."

Epitome – सार – The perfect example of a particular quality or type.
Example: "She is the epitome of grace and elegance."

Conclusion:
"Epitome" is the best synonym for "paragon" because both words signify the highest standard or ideal representation, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

It is of paramount importance that you read the instructions before attempting the test.
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Remind
Rehearse
Central
Rephrase
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Central

paramount - Central

Explanation:
"Paramount" means of the greatest importance or significance, and "central" also refers to something that is of primary importance.
"Paramount" का अर्थ है सर्वोच्च महत्व का, और "central" भी किसी प्राथमिक महत्व की चीज़ को दर्शाता है।

Example: "Please remind me to call my mother later."

Rehearse – अभ्यास करना – Practice (a play, piece of music, etc.) for later performance.
Example: "The actors will rehearse the scene again before the show."

Rephrase – दोबारा कहना – Express (an idea or question) in a different way.
Example: "Could you rephrase your question so I can understand better?"

Central – मुख्य – Of the greatest importance; principal.
Example: "Education plays a central role in personal development."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "central" is the best synonym for "paramount" because both words convey the idea of something being of the highest importance. The other options do not match the meaning of "paramount."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Paranoia
(Selection Post Higher Secondary Level)
options: Faith
Anxiety
Assurance
Belief
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Anxiety

Paranoia - Anxiety

Explanation:
Paranoia refers to an irrational and intense fear or suspicion, which aligns closely with anxiety—a feeling of worry or unease.
पैरानॉइड का अर्थ है अतार्किक और तीव्र भय या संदेह, जो चिंता (एंग्जायटी) से मेल खाता है—एक चिंता या बेचैनी की भावना।

Other synonyms Words:
Fear, Suspicion, Distrust, Unease, Worry

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Paranoia – संदेहात्मक भय – An irrational distrust of others or extreme anxiety.
Example: "His paranoia made him believe everyone was plotting against him."

Faith – विश्वास – Complete trust or confidence in someone or something.
Example: "She had faith in her team's ability to succeed."

Assurance – आश्वासन – A positive declaration intended to give confidence.
Example: "The manager gave her assurance that the project would be completed on time."

Belief – विश्वास – An acceptance that something exists or is true.
Example: "His belief in justice kept him motivated."

Anxiety – चिंता – A feeling of worry or nervousness.
Example: "Her anxiety increased as the exam date approached."

Conclusion:
While "faith," "assurance," and "belief" are positive and trusting, "anxiety" is the most appropriate synonym for "paranoia" as both involve fear and unease.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Paranoid
(CGLE 2021 Tier I)
options: Committed
Distrustful
Convinced
Trustful
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Distrustful

Paranoid - Distrustful

Explanation:
"Paranoid" refers to an irrational or excessive distrust of others. "Distrustful" is the most appropriate synonym as it conveys a similar sense of suspicion and lack of trust.
पैरानॉयड का अर्थ है दूसरों के प्रति तर्कहीन या अत्यधिक अविश्वास। "Distrustful" इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह संदेह और अविश्वास की भावना को व्यक्त करता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Suspicious, Fearful, Insecure, Nervous, Anxious

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Paranoid – संदेहशील – (Having an irrational fear or distrust of others)
Example: "He became paranoid after the incident and started doubting everyone around him."

Committed – प्रतिबद्ध – (Dedicated to a cause or activity)
Example: "She is committed to her work and never misses a deadline."

Convinced – आश्वस्त – (Fully persuaded or certain about something)
Example: "After seeing the evidence, he was convinced of her innocence."

Trustful – विश्वासपूर्ण – (Having or showing trust in others)
Example: "Children are naturally trustful of their parents."

Distrustful – अविश्वासी – (Lacking trust; suspicious)
Example: "After being betrayed, she became distrustful of new friends."

Conclusion:
"Distrustful" is the best synonym for "paranoid" because both words describe a state of suspicion and lack of trust, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The Government is planning to irrigate the ________ desert land by using water from the nearby river. (parched)
(Stenographer Grade C and D Examination 2023)
options: rustic
arid
only
lush
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: arid

parched - arid

Explanation:
The word "parched" means extremely dry, especially due to hot weather. "Arid" is the correct synonym as it also describes land that is very dry and lacking moisture.
वर्ड "parched" का अर्थ है अत्यधिक सूखा, विशेष रूप से गर्म मौसम के कारण। "Arid" सही समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह उस भूमि का वर्णन करता है जो बहुत सूखी और नमी से रहित है।

Other synonyms Words:
dry, barren, dehydrated, scorched, thirsty

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

parched – सूखा – (adjective) dried out with heat; extremely thirsty.
Example: "The parched land desperately needed rain."

rustic – ग्रामीण – (adjective) relating to the countryside; simple and unsophisticated.
Example: "They enjoyed the rustic charm of the village."

only – केवल – (adverb) no more than; solely.
Example: "She was the only person who understood."

lush – हरा-भरा – (adjective) growing luxuriantly; rich in vegetation.
Example: "The garden was lush with tropical plants."

arid – शुष्क – (adjective) extremely dry; lacking moisture.
Example: "The arid desert stretched for miles."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "arid" is the best synonym for "parched" as both describe extreme dryness, particularly in the context of land or climate. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.
The crowds gathered were partisan in nature.

(SICPO Paper I 2022)
options: pitiful
biased
Kind
Destructive
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: biased

partisan - biased

Explanation:
The word "partisan" refers to someone who strongly supports a particular party, cause, or person, often without considering other viewpoints, which aligns with the meaning of "biased."
"पक्षपाती" शब्द किसी विशेष पक्ष, कारण या व्यक्ति का दृढ़ता से समर्थन करने वाले को दर्शाता है, जो अक्सर अन्य दृष्टिकोणों पर विचार किए बिना होता है, जो "biased" के अर्थ के अनुरूप है।

Other synonyms Words:
prejudiced, one-sided, partial, discriminatory, unfair

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

partisan – पक्षपाती – Strongly supporting a particular group or cause, often unreasonably.
Example: "The crowds gathered were partisan in nature."

pitiful – दयनीय – Deserving or arousing pity.
Example: "The homeless man looked pitiful in the cold."

Kind – दयालु – Having a friendly, generous, or considerate nature.
Example: "She is always kind to animals."

Destructive – विनाशकारी – Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.
Example: "The hurricane had a destructive impact on the coastal town."

biased – पक्षपातपूर्ण – Unfairly favoring one side over another.
Example: "The judge was accused of being biased in his decision."

Conclusion:
"Biased" is the best synonym for "partisan" because both words describe an unfair preference for one side, often disregarding objectivity. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

Increase – वृद्धि – To become greater in number or amount.

Excess – अधिकता – An amount that is more than necessary.
Example: "Excess sugar consumption can harm health."

Scarcity – अभाव – The state of being in short supply.
Example: "The scarcity of water is a serious issue in many regions."

Conclusion:
"Scarcity" is the best synonym for "paucity" as both indicate a lack or shortage, unlike the other options which suggest abundance or growth.

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: economical

Explanation:
"Penurious" means extremely poor or stingy, but it can also imply being frugal or economical with resources. "Economical" fits as a synonym because it denotes careful management of resources without waste.

frugal, thrifty, sparing, prudent, stingy

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Example: "The penurious old man refused to spend even on basic necessities."

prodigal – फिजूलखर्च – Wastefully extravagant.
Example: "His prodigal spending habits left him bankrupt."

extravagant – अत्यधिक खर्चीला – Lacking restraint in spending money.
Example: "She led an extravagant lifestyle, buying luxury cars and designer clothes."

benevolent – दयालु – Kind and generous.
Example: "The benevolent donor contributed generously to the charity."

economical – मितव्ययी – Careful in spending money or using resources.
Example: "He was economical with his earnings, saving for future needs."

Conclusion:
"Economical" is the best synonym for "penurious" in the context of being frugal or careful with resources, while the other options either mean the opposite (prodigal, extravagant) or are unrelated (benevolent).
